data.long_meaning: The name Royalta is of English origin, meaning Royal or Regal. This name can be given to a boy, symbolizing his status as a prince or king. The name Royalta carries the meaning “Royal, Regal” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Royalta usually hope their child will grow to embody royal, regal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Christian tradition, the name Royalta can also represent the spiritual kingship of God in our lives.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Royalta total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Royalta has a rich cultural history and significance, not only in Christianity but also in other cultures and societies that emphasize nobility and royalty. In Christianity, it can represent the belief that every believer has a royal identity in Christ through His kingdom and priesthood (1 Peter 2:9, Revelation 1:6). This name can inspire a sense of dignity, respect, and authority. Additionally, it can be a reminder of the golden era of Christianity's history when kings and queens embraced the faith and shaped the culture around them.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Royalta carries a deeper spiritual meaning beyond its royal connotation. It can be seen as a reminder of our true identity in Christ, as children of God and members of His royal family (Ephesians 2:6). It can inspire a sense of honor, respect, and obedience towards our heavenly Father, as kings and priests who serve Him and represent His kingdom on earth. It can also be a source of hope and motivation, as we remember that through Christ, we have the power and authority to overcome any challenge or obstacle, just as a king would. In essence, the name Royalta can serve as a constant reminder of our royal identity in Christ and the spiritual blessings and responsibilities that come with it.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Royalta: God's royalty bestowed upon an individual, granting them dignity, worth, and a sense of purpose in the divine kingdom. In the eyes of the Creator, every believer is a cherished member of the royal family, destined for greatness and eternal glory.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Royalta is mentioned in the 12th century as a variant of the name Royal The name Royalta carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Royalta remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Royalta, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Royalta meaning "Royal, Regal" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
